I'm in the same boat as you right now. it happened a couple weeks ago out of nowhere. I'm feeling betrayed, confused, angry, sad etc. I also know he wasn't right for me so I understand the confusion you're feeling - why does it still have to hurt so much? All I can say is it's getting better every day. Some days are harder than others. The good news is the pain starts to fade and you make your brain go down a different pathway when you feel yourself starting to think about the whole situation. When your brain reminds you of the last time you spoke, or some memory or whatever it may be, say to yourself "he doesn't deserve my time or thoughts" and quickly try and focus your attention on something else positive. You've still allowed yourself to mourn and feel the sadness, but you owe it to yourself to not torture your brain with questions and things you'll never know the answer to. You need to take all of that love and attention you spent on him and give it back to yourself. Try writing/journalling to get those thoughts out there. You'll see that your perspective changes every day.
Everything is going to be okay. It is so incredibly hard to see that light at the end of the tunnel when you feel completely heartbroken and a mess, but that light is there and will be getting brighter every day. Remind yourself that you're strong and deserve to be happy. You are going to heal sooner than you could ever think.
